title: Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card Rate Card
content:
Bulk ordering in the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program applies to the Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card, whose smallest bulk order is 250.00 USD and whose bulk discount rises with the order's total value. For every other card type the smallest bulk order figure is 0.00, meaning bulk ordering does not apply, and the discount is 0.0 percent across all order values. Each type also has a most-cards-per-order figure.

## Bulk discount schedule, Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card

| Order value from (USD) | Order value to (USD) | Discount on the order |
|---|---|---|
| 250.00 | 4999.99 | 0.0 percent |
| 5000.00 | 24999.99 | 1.0 percent |
| 25000.00 | 999999.99 | 2.0 percent |

The band is read on the order's total value; the discount is that percentage of the order's total value.

## Order figures by card type

| Card type | Smallest bulk order (USD) | Discount by order value | Most cards in one order |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | 0.00, bulk ordering does not apply | 0.0 percent from 0.00 to 999999.99 | 10 |
| Northgate eGift Card | 0.00, bulk ordering does not apply | 0.0 percent from 0.00 to 999999.99 | 10 |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | 0.00, bulk ordering does not apply | 0.0 percent from 0.00 to 999999.99 | 1 |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | 0.00, bulk ordering does not apply | 0.0 percent from 0.00 to 999999.99 | 1 |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | 250.00 | the schedule above | 2500 |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | 0.00, bulk ordering does not apply | 0.0 percent from 0.00 to 999999.99 | 2 |

## Band edges (hypothetical order values)

| Hypothetical bulk order total | Band | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 249.99 | below the smallest bulk order of 250.00 | no bulk order |
| 250.00 | first band | 0.0 percent |
| 4999.99 | first band | 0.0 percent |
| 5000.00 | second band | 1.0 percent |
| 24999.99 | second band | 1.0 percent |
| 25000.00 | third band | 2.0 percent |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card order totalling 8000.00 falls in the band from 5000.00 to 24999.99, so its discount is 1.0 percent of 8000.00, which is 80.00. An order totalling 30000.00 falls in the third band, and its discount is 2.0 percent of 30000.00, which is 600.00.
